title: 🐛 CAT THRONE WHITE SCREEN — ROOT CAUSE FOUND
items: Cat Bullet King Throne White Overlay Fix: The secret _CuriousCatStareWidget used a Positioned widget directly inside AnimatedBuilder (not a Stack), so its width/height constraints were ignored and the cat image was stretched to fill the entire screen as a semi-transparent white overlay. Now wrapped in a Stack so Positioned works correctly — the cat peeks from the bottom-right corner as intended.

title: 🐛 WHITE SCREEN FIX — SCAFFOLD TRANSPARENCY
items: White Opaque Screen Fix: Root cause identified as scaffoldBackgroundColor in AppTheme.themeFor() being 90% opaque when hypnoticBg was disabled. This obscured ThemeOverlay backgrounds (wallpapers, particles, galaxy) on any screen without explicit transparent Scaffold. Now always transparent — ThemeOverlay provides the base solid color via its own Container layer.

Full Screen Audit: All 10+ pushed screens (Multiplayer Lobby, Multiplayer Connect, Synergies Overview, Stats Detail, Shrine Picker, Item Detail, Favourites, Effects Summary, Character Select, HomeScreen loading/error states) now explicitly set backgroundColor: Colors.transparent on both Scaffold and AppBar.

title: 🐛 VISUAL POLISH — PARALLAX, OVERLAY, WIND ARTIFACTS, THEME BG
items: Smooth Parallax: Converted still wallpaper background to a StatefulWidget with AnimationController for buttery 60fps exponential lerp of gyroscope tilt values. No more sensor jitter or low FPS.

Quick Add Overlay Fix: Fixed race condition where a bright white overlay appeared when quick-adding items. Now uses FocusManager unfocus + PostFrameCallback to sequence modal dismissal before navigation.

Wind Path Artifacts Removed: Eliminated wobbly 'wind current' bezier curve rendering from all particle backdrops (Gold Dust, Hellfire, Cosmic Rift, Custom Particles). No more ghostly lines drifting upward.
Lingering Background Fix: ThemePickerScreen Scaffold was opaque (90% alpha), hiding ThemeOverlay backgrounds during preview and causing a flash when popping. Now transparent like all other screens.

title: 🤖 ROBOT TERMINAL + THEME OVERHAUL + 10 NEW THEMES
items: Robot Dashboard Redesign: Fixed font overflow on junk toggles. Gold Junk and Lies toggles are now bigger, more compact tap targets with icon + label + subtitle layout. DMG boost badge is now larger and more prominent.

Robot Damage Calculator Terminal: Added expandable retro green terminal showing per-gun damage calculations (weapon name, base DPS, robot-boosted DPS, and delta) with monospace styling and total DPS summary.

Theme Picker Redesign: Removed chip rows from theme preview cards. Replaced with per-theme custom preview data (stats, bullet notes) for all 21 themes. Added continuous weighted palette swatch bar showing BG/CRD/PRI/SEC/ACC with actual hex colors as fill.

10 New Themes Added: Gungeon Proper (castle stone blue), The Oubliette (sludge green), Past Paradox (cosmic cyan), High Priest Void (cultist purple), Robot's Core (circuit teal), Cult of Gundead (brass gold), Synergy Surge (blue arrow teal), Glitched Chest (artifact magenta), Lich's Tomb (phantom teal), Winchester's Game (ticket orange).
Per-Theme Preview Data: All 21 themes now have custom stats, bullet notes, and subheadings that showcase their palette identity with real Gungeon flavor.

title: 🎨 UNICORN THEME FAMILY + HUD & EFFECT FIXES
items: Special Gun Panels Fix: Fixed substring matching bug where Ser Junkan, Gunderfury, and Triple Gun dashboards appeared for characters who don't possess those items. Now uses exact name matching (== 'ser junkan' instead of contains('ser junkan')).

Status Effects Rendering Fix: Replaced all 45+ 'Status Effects' lore ref tokens across items.json and guns.json with context-specific effect words (fire, poison, frozen, stun, stealth, charm, etc.). Effects like 'sets enemies on fire' and 'green bullets that poison enemies' now display correctly instead of showing a generic italic 'Status Effects' link.
Unicorn Theme: Removed twinkling star sparkle particles from the original Unicorn Bubblegum theme. The ambient pink/teal glow remains — just no more twinkling stars.
Unicorn II (Neon): New theme variation — neon-charged cotton candy with hot pink (#FF1493), electric teal (#00CED1), and bright orchid. Stronger glow intensity for a radioactive neon vibe.

Unicorn III (Dream): New theme variation — softer whispered cotton candy with blush pink (#F8BBD0), sage teal (#80CBC4), and dusty lavender. Rounded 20px corners and gentle glow for a watercolour dream feel.
Unicorn IV (Sunset): New theme variation — cotton candy at golden hour with coral pink (#FF6B9D), warm peach (#FFAB91), and golden teal (#4DB6AC). Sunset-drenched romantic vibe.
MP Auto-Reconnect Plan: Created comprehensive implementation plan for automated multiplayer save/reconnect system at docs/mp_auto_reconnect_plan.md.

title: 🐛 DATA CORRECTIONS & DEVOLVER HUD FIX
items: Monster Blood: Fixed first wiki note to include Robot's 5-10 coin drop range.
Grappling Hook: Replaced 'Status Effects' reference with inline 'stuns' text for clarity.
Budget Revolver: Removed incorrect Exit the Gungeon dual stats — now shows only Enter the Gungeon values.
Big Iron: Fixed range from '16 15' to correct value of 16.
Heroine: Fixed DPS and damage fields to properly label all three charge levels (Level 1/2/3).
M16: DPS now includes Machine Gun, Grenade Launcher, and Combined DPS values.
Devolver HUD Fix: Fixed a substring matching bug where 'Devolver' triggered the Evolver HUD dashboard due to contains('evolver') matching. Now uses exact name match.

title: 🔮 GLASSMORPHIC SETTINGS PANELS
items: Glassmorphic Settings Panels: Unified all settings screen panels (Typography, Inventory Grid, Particle Tuning, Switch Rows) and settings sheet dropdown/rows to use a consistent glassy aesthetic with flair.card at 35-38% alpha and themed primary borders. Panels now show the background through them subtly while remaining fully readable — no more nearly-invisible white-on-white containers.

title: ⚡ PARTICLE SYSTEM OVERHAUL, FPS FIX & PARALLAX REWORK
items: Elemental Particle Types: Completely reworked the custom particle type system to 7 distinct elemental types — Fire (embers & sparks), Water (bubbles & droplets), Earth (dust & stone pebbles), Air (wind gusts & streaks), Bullets (golden shells & brass casings), Gunpowder (smoke puffs & muzzle flash sparks), and Stars (cosmic sparkles with white cores). Removed all old emoji-based particles (necromantic skulls, skeletal bones, tombstone crosses, rainbow prismatic, frost, toxic, lightning, gold/brass/steel).

Massive FPS Optimization: Removed all expensive MaskFilter.blur calls from particle painters (curse fog, sparkles, hellfire, gold dust wind, cosmic rift wind). Replaced curse fog's blur(45) with cheap RadialGradient shaders. Replaced sparkle glow halos with cheap concentric alpha-gradient circles. Added RepaintBoundary to custom particle backdrop. Removed Gun_Fairy.webp async asset load that was wasting memory.

Particle Cutoff Fix: Removed all modulo wrapping (% size.height, % size.width) from particle position calculations across all 10+ backdrop painters. Particles now travel fully off-screen before fading out instead of wrapping around abruptly.

Parallax Rework for Large Screens: Increased accelerometer clamp range from ±6 to ±10 and smoothing factor from 0.12 to 0.18 for more responsive tilt. Still wallpaper parallax now scales by screen dimensions (screenSize.width * 0.015) instead of fixed 3.8px, so bigger phones get proportional movement. Lowered image filter quality to low for better FPS.

title: 🦄 UNICORN BUBBLEGUM REWORK & PARTICLE COUNT CONTROL
items: Unicorn Bubblegum Theme Visual Rework: Completely reworked the sparkle particle painter with a 6-color pastel palette (hot pink, lavender, mint cyan, soft pink, amethyst, white), dual-layer glow halos with MaskFilter blur, three distinct shape varieties (4-point star, glowing bubble, 6-point double-star), and bright white cores for a premium magical cotton-candy aesthetic.

Particle Count Now Affects Theme-Default Particles: Wired the user-controlled particle count slider to all 9 theme-default backdrop widgets (GoldDust, Sparkles, BrassMotes, IceCrystals, WhiteDust, ToxicBubbles, ForgeEmbers, Hellfire, CosmicRift). Previously these used hardcoded counts that ignored the user's density preference.
Live Particle Count Regeneration: Added didUpdateWidget to every theme-default backdrop widget so particle specs regenerate immediately when the count slider changes — no app restart needed.

title: 👾 RETRO GLITCH CINEMATIC BREACH & PROMPT HARMONIZATION
items: Dynamic 3D Retro Glitch Cinematic: Developed a cinematic intro system in glitch_intro.html with responsive Tailwind CSS, realistic camera forward POV corridor runs, and screen slamming transitions.

Analog Audio Sound Synthesis: Implemented Web Audio API sound generator to synthesize authentic retro glitch lasers, heavy bass impacts, and screen clicks without requiring extra media asset downloads.

Interactive Particle Exploser: Programmed a high-performance physical particle blast on canvas that triggers on screen slam, throwing dithered, outline-glowing block particles directly at the viewport with active bounce.

GungeonMate Live Replica: Rendered a stunning, high-fidelity dark-neon interactive mockup of GungeonMate's actual home layout with an active, drifting space galaxy and hover effects as the portal destination.

1:1 Image-Matched Glitch Prompts: Completely refined the Glitch Chest Neon theme prompts (#1, #2, #3) in assets/data/themes.json and wallpaper_tracker.html to precisely mirror the uploaded circuit wireframe perspective corridor, bullet silhouette tracks, and CRT narrow analog scanline hallway images.

title: 🧹 THE GREAT UI CONDENSATION & GALAXY HOME SCREEN
items: Simplified Particle Options: Stripped the particle settings down to just Type and Density — completely removed sizing, emitters, rotation, gravity vortex, flicker, subtle mode, and touch sparkles for perfect, pre-tuned handcrafted excellence.

Swipe-to-Select Pickers: Replaced all dropdowns for Wallpaper Mode, Still/Animated Wallpaper selection, and Font Family with beautiful horizontal swipe pickers featuring live previews and animated scaling.
Wallpaper Section Moved Up: Relocated the Wallpaper & Parallax Engine Lab higher in the Settings menu, above particles and typography, for faster access.

Galaxy Always on Home with Particles: The swirling Galaxy animated background plays on the Main Menu Home screen, and premium particles now drift gracefully in front of it and all other background wallpapers.
Enhanced Readability Scrim: Added a stronger gradient darkening overlay when any wallpaper or the Galaxy background is active, keeping all foreground panels, cards, and text crisp and readable.
Swipe-Only Theme Picker: Removed all option rows and tuning panels from the Theme Picker screen — it is now a pure swipe-to-preview palette selector.

title: 🖼️ THE WALLPAPER & GYROSCOPIC PARALLAX ENGINE LAB
items: Exclusive Still Wallpapers: Bundled 19 gorgeous high-fidelity pixel-art scenes covering Gungeon chambers, weapons, and characters in assets/images/wallpapers/still/.
Gyroscopic Parallax Motion: Created a hardware-accelerated parallax engine that dynamically sways and offsets the background image based on the physical phone tilt accelerometer readings.
Animated Live Loops: Integrated a high-performance video player engine to play seamless 8-second looping MP4 backgrounds (vortex galaxy, weapons racks, sewer gelatin) with elegant fallback support.
Unified Settings Lab: Designed a dedicated 'Wallpaper & Parallax Engine Lab' section inside both Settings and the Premium Theme Picker to manage selections and toggles in perfect unison.

title: 🎨 THE INVENTORY DENSITY & LEGIBILITY CONTROL LAB
items: Flexible Inventory Grid Density: Added a customizable periodic grid column count setting in Style Lab and Settings, allowing users on standard/compact phones to seamlessly scale the inventory layout between 2 (compact), 3 (medium), or 4 (dense) columns.

Premium Subtle Particle Mode: Introduced an advanced legibility toggle that halves background particle counts across all custom presets and theme-specific backdrops, maximizing text readability in low-light environments without sacrificing the beautiful floating ambiance.
Integrated Style Lab Options: Consolidated all grid layout, periodic columns, and inventory text scaling options under a unified, beautiful 'Inventory Grid & Display Tuning' section.
Unified Customization Panels: Reorganized the full Vibe & Customization Tuning panels inside the Premium Theme Picker to stay perfectly in sync with the primary settings screens.

title: ⚙️ THE PREMIUM PARTICLE REDESIGN & GLOBAL GOOP CONVERSION
items: Categorized Particle Themes: Critically redesigned all background custom particles and grouped them into Elements (Ember, Frost, Toxic, Lightning, Rainbow), Metal (Golden Shells, Brass Casings, Steel Sparks), and Bone (Necrotic Skull, Skeletal Ashes, Tombstone Dust).
Dynamic Wind and 3D Z-Depth: Added flowing colored background wind paths and physical diagonal vector winds to all premium custom particles, and added Z-depth parallax scale factors.
Global GoopText Integration: Wrapped all Database Search row results, Item/Gun Detail titles, and Shrine Picker modal attributes in GoopText, so they convert dynamically to Goopian in perfect unison.
Consolidated Procedural Backgrounds: Removed raw static GIF options to exclusively use our ultra-clean, high-performance, GPU-accelerated animated procedural backdrops.

title: 📺 THE PROCEDURAL BACKGROUNDS & SPECIAL HUD REFACTOR UPDATE
items: Special Inventory HUDs: Gunderfury, Triple Gun, and Evolver are now fully rendered as separate, detailed dashboard panels right after the main player character DASH, just like Ser Junkan!
Procedural Animated Backgrounds: Introduced high-performance, real-time CRT Analog Static and Cyber Glitch Screen backdrops, painted entirely procedurally via hardware-accelerated canvas commands.
Central Dimming Readability Mask: Applied a deep radial gradient vignette over the center and corners of all animated backgrounds, ensuring that card text, labels, and icons remain 100% readable.
Settings Tooltip showDuration: Calibrated info-tooltip popups under the Style Lab Settings screen to stay visible for 5 full seconds instead of vanishing too quickly.

Dynamic Particle Gyro sways: Hooked up real-time accelerometer tilt forces to all default and custom particle systems, allowing floating stars, cat paws, and gunfairies to sway organically as you tilt your phone.

title: 🏹 THE PRE-RELEASE GENERAL UX & SYSTEM POLISH UPDATE
items: Polymorphic Theme Refactor: Moved all theme flair definitions directly into enum templates, removing thousands of lines of scattered switch-case blocks.

Redesigned Tactical Stats: Created wide double-column inventory cards showing a full 6-parameter stats spreadsheet on top of a giant blurred background gun/item icon, complete with active fire-mode/type tags.

Shrine Picker Upgrades: Cleanse shrine is now sorted to the absolute top of the list, activation sheet graphics are enlarged to a giant 120x120 size, and explicit 'Heart Container -1' penalty badges are displayed for Angel and Blood shrines.
App Appearance Compaction: Consolidated all font-tuning dropdowns and sliders into a single unified card in Settings with ultra-compact 32px slider track profiles.

Huntress HUD Slider: Implemented an information-dense sliding tab dashboard showing Junior II dog item drop weights (doubling to 10% if Baby Good Mimic is held), Crossbow HP breakpoints, and Oubliette/Abbey key economies.
Main Menu Aesthetics: Enlarged GungeonMate title outlines and ribbons on the main menu, and expanded our central Tailor mascot with 16 new highly detailed Gungeon-lore quotes.
Tactile ScaleButton Integration: Wrapped all primary main menu categories, the Tailor mascot, and Gunfortuna dice triggers in physical bouncy button scaling and automatic haptics.
Optimized Display Options: Permanently deleted wonky, unpolished views ('RPG Bag rows' and 'Gallery Display') and redundant tips menus to keep the app lean, fast, and optimized.

Goopian Language Mode: Added an immersive Goopian translation engine option in Settings. Activating it converts mascot dialogues and gun/item titles into Professor Goopton's unreadable cipher symbols.

The Sponge 🧽 Mode Toggle: Implemented a prominent, glowing interactive Sponge button in the Active Run app bar when Goopian is active. Tapping it magically runs a matrix-deciphering translation stream to reveal readable English text.

title: 🎯 THE ROAD TO 1.0: PRE-RELEASE CONSOLIDATION
items: Version Scheme Revamp: Reset and consolidated app versioning, laying the stable foundation for our official Play Store launch in July!
Premium Companion Features: Clean and highly optimized run tracking, synergies reference, dual-telemetry tactical stat grid layouts, and active co-op syncing.
Completely Free: GungeonMate is 100% free and open-source for all Enter the Gungeon fans to use, track, and master their runs.
Dynamic Stylization: Real-time theme picker previews, particle customizers, and physical hardware gyroscope sways are fully calibrated for maximum smoothness.
Optimized APK Build: Compiled a highly streamlined, high-performance production-ready release APK available for direct sideloading.
